newsitem.title: INDIA: India panel seeks more divestment in five firms.
newsitem.headline: India panel seeks more divestment in five firms.

text.p: India's Disinvestment Commission said on Friday it had recommended a strategy for partial privatisation of five firms including the Container Corp of India, Kudremukh Iron Ore Co and Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd (MTNL).

Commission chairman G.V. Ramakrishna told a news conference that in the case of Oil India Ltd and the Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) the commission had recommended changes in the firms to be effected before any sale of shares was undertaken.

ONGC, which accounts for nearly 90 percent of India's oil and gas production, reported net profit for 1996/97 (April-March) rose slightly to 19.75 billion rupees from 19.45 billion in the previous year.
Oil India, India's second-largest oil producer after ONGC, is 97 percent owned by the government with its employees holding the remaining three percent.
